options.content: **Coverage differs.** Servers = hosts scraped by the IPMI exporter (the OpenStack fleet only). Switches = every Cumulus switch in NetBox for the site, including racks with no monitored servers. A rack total is therefore *our hosts + all switches*, not the rack's full draw. PDUs = metered draw from the rack PDUs (SNMP); they already include the servers and switches plugged into them, so they are shown alongside, not added to Total.
